requirements.name: SystemArchitecture
requirements.description: The controller has 12 modes (M1, M2, M3, M4, M5, M6, M7, M8, M9, M10, M11, Final), reads 11 real-valued sensor readings, and issues a combined linear/angular velocity command. It starts in M1.

requirements.name: M1EndTask
requirements.description: In mode M1, on EndTask the controller enters Final and commands zero velocity.

requirements.name: M1Advance
requirements.description: In mode M1, on Advance when reading1 is at most threshold1, the controller enters M2 and commands forward velocity.

requirements.name: M1Retreat
requirements.description: In mode M1, on Retreat when reading1 exceeds threshold1, the controller enters M1 and commands zero velocity.

requirements.name: M1Tick
requirements.description: In mode M1, a Tick leaves the controller in M1.
